images.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: entirely NEW Dragon Database form-card illustration, created from TEXT ONLY with no reference images.
Primary request: an original mature dangerous dragon individual in a completely new scene, not an edit, recolor or pose variant of existing artwork. Dramatic powerful fantasy form, sharp fangs and intense predatory eyes, sophisticated epic storybook art.
Style/medium: vivid richly painted gouache and watercolor fantasy illustration, tactile brush texture, fine ink-like details on scales/feathers/armor, luminous atmosphere and strong cinematic separation. No photo or 3D rendering.
Composition: horizontal landscape 5:3 full-bleed. One centrally dominant complete creature occupying roughly 65–80% of the frame, crisp detailed readable silhouette against a quiet softer lower-contrast epic environment. The full outer bounding shape of the creature fits comfortably inside the image. Keep EVERY wing tip, horn, head, foot and tail inside the frame with natural background breathing room; no close crop or clipped wings. Protect the main anatomy from overlap/clutter so the form reads on a small shallow card.
Constraints: exactly the stated creature anatomy; no extra creatures or people. No text, lettering, signatures, logos, watermarks, borders, frames, interface or gore. Preserve the specific new identity, scene and palette.
Scene: a MOONLIT MIDNIGHT-INDIGO GORGE, soft dark canyon silhouettes, a silver river far below and ONE HUGE PALE MOON behind thin atmospheric cloud washes. Quiet dark blue scenery, very low background detail, a few luminous silver water reflections; no warm peach temple, golden daytime clouds or red sunset.
Subject identity: a long muscular BLACK-PLUM AND SILVER scaled AMPHIPTERE, its thick continuous serpentine torso armored in deep plum-black scales with bright silver ventral plates. Exactly TWO enormous PALE SILVER-IVORY FEATHERED WINGS attach near its shoulders. Absolutely NO legs, NO feet, NO separate arms or hands. A long slender FANG-LINED DRAGON FACE with a reptilian muzzle (NOT a bird beak), long hooked crown horns and bright GOLD predatory eyes. Open snarling jaws, tense muscular neck, unmistakably draconic rather than a bird. Dynamic aggressive ASCENDING S-COIL with its head thrust upward to the LEFT, serpentine tail trailing in a powerful twist, both sweeping pale wings fully spread and completely inside frame. Keep a continuous legless body and exactly two wing attachments obvious. Pale feathers, silver scales and moon rim light strongly separate its plum-black torso from the dark indigo backdrop.
Palette/distinctness: black-plum scaled body, silver armor, pale ivory/silver feathers, small intense gold eyes, midnight-indigo gorge/moon. NO crimson or red/gold body, NO gold feather wings, NO bat-membrane wings and NO warm mountain temple. This is a new individual with hooked crown horns and a slender feral dragon skull, not a familiar red feathered serpent repainted. Pale sweeping wings should dominate the dark scene, with both entire tips surrounded by visible dark sky.
